relations.text: 株主グループが買収を提案
relations.text_en: Investor group proposed to buy it

source.label: The Wendy's Company 8-K(2026年11月)
source.quote: The Board adopted the Rights Agreement in response to the unsolicited, non-binding proposal made on October 28, 2026 by Trian and Flynn Group LP, BlueFive Capital and Sixth Street Partners (together, the "Investor Group"), to acquire all of the Common Shares not currently owned by the Investor Group for $7.35 per Common Share.
